title: Passage 53
voice: 温暖自然英式女老师｜IndexTTS2.5 慢速教学

sentences.en: Look at the Earth from space.
sentences.cn: 从太空俯瞰地球吧。

sentences.en: Our planet looks so blue, because water covers nearly three quarters of its surface.
sentences.cn: 我们的星球看起来如此蔚蓝，因为水覆盖了其表面近四分之三。

sentences.en: Water is an important part of our body, too.
sentences.cn: 水也是我们身体的重要组成部分。

sentences.en: More than half of our total body weight is water.
sentences.cn: 我们总体重的一半以上都是水。

sentences.en: Our body loses water whenever we play sports like football, or go to the toilet.
sentences.cn: 每当我们进行踢足球等运动或上厕所时，身体就会流失水分。

sentences.en: That's why we need to drink plenty of water every day.
sentences.cn: 这就是我们每天需要饮用大量水的原因。

sentences.en: We use water to cook, clean, and we then carry waste out of our homes.
sentences.cn: 我们用水做饭、打扫，然后我们再将垃圾带出家门。

sentences.en: We use it to take a bath or wash dishes and chopsticks in the kitchen.
sentences.cn: 我们也用水洗澡或在厨房清洗碗碟和筷子。

sentences.en: Farmers use it to grow crops like rice, corn, carrots and tomatoes; factories use it to make products.
sentences.cn: 农民用水种植水稻、玉米、胡萝卜和西红柿等农作物；工厂用水制造产品。

sentences.en: Since the 1950s, as the population grew, the amount of water that people have used has increased by three times.
sentences.cn: 自20世纪50年代以来，随着人口的增长，人们的用水量增加了三倍。

sentences.en: But the water supply hasn't.
sentences.cn: 但供水量却没有增加。

sentences.en: Scientists worry that soon there won't be enough water for us,
sentences.cn: 科学家们担心，不久之后将没有足够的水供我们使用，与我们共同生活在这个世界上的动植物也面临同样的问题。

sentences.en: as well as for the animals and plants that share our world.
sentences.cn: 科学家们担心，不久之后将没有足够的水供我们使用，与我们共同生活在这个世界上的动植物也面临同样的问题。

sentences.en: What can we do to help?
sentences.cn: 我们能帮上什么忙呢？

sentences.en: Use water wisely.
sentences.cn: 明智地用水吧。

sentences.en: Not having enough water isn't the only problem that we need to solve.
sentences.cn: 缺乏充足的水资源并非我们需要解决的唯一问题。

sentences.en: We also need it to be clean.
sentences.cn: 我们还需要水是干净的。

sentences.en: Right now, ships and factories are putting wastes into seas, rivers and lakes.
sentences.cn: 现在，船舶和工厂正在向海洋、河流和湖泊排放废物。

sentences.en: Even chemicals that farmers use are running into rivers and lakes.
sentences.cn: 甚至农民使用的化学制品也在流入河流和湖泊。

sentences.en: All this pollution can make the water dangerous to drink and cause diseases like cancer.
sentences.cn: 所有这些污染都可能使水源变得危险，不宜饮用，并引发诸如癌症之类的疾病。

sentences.en: It can also harm fish, whales and other aquatic life.
sentences.cn: 污染还会危害鱼类、鲸和其他水生生物。

sentences.en: We must do something to stop pollution.
sentences.cn: 我们必须采取措施阻止污染。

sentences.en: It's the best way to protect our world's most valuable natural resource.
sentences.cn: 这是保护我们世界上最宝贵的自然资源的最佳方式。
